names.en: Siida - Sámi Museum and Nature Center (Inari)
names.zh: Siida - 萨米博物馆与自然中心 (伊纳里)

derivedFrom.context: Sámi culture is living. Do not photograph locals without permission. Avoid fake costumes.

actionItem.en: Buy handicrafts only with the 'Sámi Duodji' label. Treat the culture with respect.
actionItem.zh: 仅购买带有 'Sámi Duodji' 标签的手工艺品。以尊重的态度对待当地文化。

derivedFrom.context: Long distances, sparse gas stations, moose collisions.

actionItem.en: Fill tank whenever below 50%. Keep headlights ON at all times. Watch for moose/reindeer.
actionItem.zh: 油量低于 50% 时立即加满。始终打开车灯。警惕驼鹿和驯鹿。

derivedFrom.context: EV range drops 30-50% in extreme cold.

actionItem.en: Plan charging stops conservatively. Verify charger functionality in apps beforehand.
actionItem.zh: 保守规划充电站点。提前在 App 中核实充电桩是否可用。

names.zh: 拉普兰森林 (浆果/蘑菇采摘点)

derivedFrom.context: Everyman's Right allows hiking/picking anywhere, provided no disturbance.

actionItem.en: Enjoy freedom to roam but stay away from private houses and yards.
actionItem.zh: 享受漫游的自由，但请远离私人住宅和庭院。
